meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码提交与改动内容做成一段可分享的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把 PR 里的改动讲给同事、用户或社区听,却不想自己录屏剪辑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into a narrated explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes on video but don't want to record and edit.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把一个 GitHub PR(代码改动)做成讲解视频:先抓取 diff、提交和文件,规划分镜与脚本,再逐帧搭建并渲染出 mp4。产出方向有 changelog、功能揭示、修复、重构讲解。
howto.when: 当你给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#N 引用,或在已检出仓库里说“这个 PR”时接管。产品宣传片、无 PR 的主题讲解不走它,分不清时先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 用 owner/repo#1842 生成改动讲解视频,旁白用男声
say.note: 可在请求里指定声音,否则用默认女声

say.text: 帮我把这个 PR 讲清楚,先给我看分镜再开始做
say.note: 它会把分镜作为提案给你确认

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub pull request (a code change) into an explainer video: it reads the PR's diff, commits, and files, plans a storyboard and script, builds frames, and renders an mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a PR URL, an owner/repo#N ref, or say “this PR” in a checked-out repo. Not for product promos or no-PR topic explainers; unclear cases go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into an explainer video: https://github.com/acme/sdk/pull/1842
say_en.note: It fetches the diff and commits, then drafts a storyboard

say_en.text: Make a change-explainer video from owner/repo#1842, male voice
say_en.note: You can name the narration voice in the request

say_en.text: Explain this PR - show me the storyboard before building
say_en.note: It presents the plan and waits for approval
